messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
Under Article 71 of Legislative Decree 81/2008, which elements must the employer take into consideration when choosing work equipment?

response.text: Ai sensi dell'articolo 71 del D.Lgs. 81/2008, quali elementi il datore di lavoro deve considerare nella scelta delle attrezzature di lavoro?
